Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.casts

package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.casts
Attribute casts for Eloquent models: the cast contract and the built-in casts.

This package holds the cast SPI and the built-in casts, plus their shared conversion support. It does not hold the model layers that apply casts; those stay package-private in org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent. The cycle between the two packages is accepted because this package holds only the SPI and the built-ins.
